text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios collapses from exhaustion. 
As a natural miler, middle-distance 
training places an immense toll on her 
body.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios, however, vowed to push 
ahead with running the Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
in order to witness her bestie's 
triumphant glory right from the track 
beside her.
